[color=#D4D4D8]Say thanks to anyone who inspired or helped you.Harvey — Semi-Realistic Portrait Replacer
Give Pelican Town's beloved doctor a fresh new look!
This mod replaces Harvey's original portraits with a more detailed, semi-realistic version, giving him a mature and expressive appearance while keeping the gentle, slightly awkward charm that makes him so lovable.
With tousled brown hair, warm eyes, subtle facial expressions, and his familiar doctor's outfit, Harvey feels a little more lifelike without losing his personality.[/color]

[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Features[/color][/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Semi-realistic art style[/b] — Detailed facial features, soft shading, and warm, natural colors.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Multiple expressions[/b] — From gentle smiles and thoughtful glances to worry, surprise, and concern.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Faithful character design[/b] — Harvey keeps his recognizable green coat, red tie, and stethoscope.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Additional details[/b] — Some portraits feature Harvey wearing headphones or using his stethoscope.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Portraiture support[/b] — Enjoy higher-resolution portraits during dialogue.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]This mod changes Harvey's dialogue portraits only. His in-game sprite remains unchanged.[/color]

[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requirements[/color][/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]SMAPI[/b] — Stardew Modding API[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Portraiture[/b] by Platonymous (Required)[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999[/url][/color]

[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Installation[/color][/size][/heading]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI and Portraiture.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this portrait pack.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the portrait folder into:[/color]

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/[/code][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Make sure the portrait file is located at:[/color]

[code]Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/Harvey/Harvey.png[/code][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game and talk to Harvey.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Press [b]P[/b] while the dialogue window is open to switch portrait sets until the new portraits appear.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Enjoy your new Harvey![/color]

[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Notes[/color][/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Portraiture is required for this mod to work.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]This mod does not change Harvey's dialogue, events, schedule, or gameplay behavior.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Other NPC portraits remain unchanged.[/color][/*]
[/list][heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thank you![/color][/size][/heading]
